runtime/time_zone#

The native layer under time/zone: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under time/zone: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Public API#

native timezone_version#

native timezone_version() is string

The version of the time zone database.

native timezone_known#

native timezone_known(name is string) is bool

Whether the database has name.

native timezone_offset#

native timezone_offset(name is string, instant is rat) is int

The offset of zone name at instant, in seconds.

native timezone_daylight#

native timezone_daylight(name is string, instant is rat) is bool

Whether daylight time is in effect then.

native timezone_abbreviation#

native timezone_abbreviation(name is string, instant is rat) is string

The zone's abbreviation then.

native timezone_local_candidates#

native timezone_local_candidates(name is string, year is int, month is int, day is int, hour is int, minute is int, second is int, nanosecond is int) is int

The instants a local time may mean in the zone: none in a gap, two in an overlap.

native timezone_local_instant#

native timezone_local_instant(name is string, year is int, month is int, day is int, hour is int, minute is int, second is int, nanosecond is int, later is bool) is rat

The instant of a local time in the zone, by the fold rule.
